info.title: Fluxora Staff Admin API
info.description: Staff API used by platform administration and staff portal https://admin-eticket.fluxorastudio.id (development: https://dev-admin-eticket.fluxorastudio.id). Staff operations use an HttpOnly fluxora_staff cookie. Partner-scoped routes are mounted under /api/staff/partners/{partnerId}/admin; platform routes under /api/staff/admin.
